Contract ManageLoanTermCRUDService::createLoanTerm(itemid: Integer,content: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		obs: Set(LoanTerm) = LoanTerm.allInstance()->select(o|o.ItemID = itemid and
		o.Content = content)
	precondition:
		itemid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		content.oclIsTypeOf(String)
	postcondition:
		let obs: Set(LoanTerm) = LoanTerm.allInstance()->select(o|o.ItemID = itemid and
		o.Content = content) in
		if obs.size()>0 
		then true 
		else let ob: LoanTerm in
		ob.oclIsNew() and
		ob.ItemID = itemid and
		ob.Content = content and
		LoanTerm.allInstance()->includes(ob) 
		endif 
}
